setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

command.command: cd /tmp && rm -rf go-cve-dictionary-v0.15.0 && mkdir go-cve-dictionary-v0.15.0 && unzip -q /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/@v/v0.15.0.zip -d go-cve-dictionary-v0.15.0 && find go-cve-dictionary-v0.15.0 -name "fortinet.go"
sed -i '/^\t\/\/ Trivy is Trivy$/a \\\t// Fortinet is Fortinet\n\tFortinet CveContentType = "fortinet"' /app/models/cvecontents.go && grep -A2 "Trivy is Trivy" /app/models/cvecontents.go

ed -s /app/models/cvecontents.go << 'EOF'
/Trivy CveContentType = "trivy"/a
	// Fortinet is Fortinet
	Fortinet CveContentType = "fortinet"
.
w
q
EOF

import re

with open('/app/models/cvecontents.go', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# We'll iterate and insert new lines.
output = []
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    output.append(line)
    # Find the line that contains 'Trivy CveContentType = "trivy"'
    if '\tTrivy CveContentType = "trivy"' in line:
        # Add Fortinet after the comment line above? Actually we want after this line? 
        # We need to insert Fortinet constant between this line and the next comment (GitHub).
        # But the constant should be after Trivy. Typically constants are listed in order.
        # Let's insert after this line.
        # Find the comment above this line: it should be '// Trivy is Trivy'
        # We want to add Fortinet constant after Trivy. We can directly after this line.
        # Add new lines with proper indentation
        output.append('\t// Fortinet is Fortinet\n')
        output.append('\tFortinet CveContentType = "fortinet"\n')
    i += 1

# Write output
with open('/app/models/cvecontents.go', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(output)

print("Added Fortinet constant")
